is_anopheles.evidence: Species of the An. gambiae s.l. complex were identified using molecular diagnostic tools. An. gambiae, An. coluzzii and An. arabiensis were identified in the different settings.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The frequency of L1014F allele (kdr West) was always >75% except in Kaélé (43.40%). The L1014S kdr allele (kdr East) was detected only in the populations of Njombé and Tibati at low frequencies. The N1575Y allele was recorded in Kaélé, Santchou, Tibati and Bertoua...

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 on page 9 reports the sample sizes (ranging from 30 to 40 per population) and the frequencies (Mean ± SE) of the kdr L1014F, L1014S, and N1575Y alleles across seven field populations.

african_field_population.evidence: Larvae and pupae were collected from the field in Cameroon (Kaélé, Tibati, Bertoua, Bélabo, Kékem, Santchou, and Njombé) and reared to F0 adults for testing.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study describing original field collections, susceptibility bioassays, and molecular genotyping of malaria vectors in Cameroon.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study identifies specific collection sites: Kaélé, Tibati, Bertoua, Bélabo, Kékem, Santchou, and Njombé.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted over three consecutive years from July 2019 to July 2021.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes routine new collections and bioassays conducted by the authors' network in Cameroon, with no indication of direct sample overlap with other published datasets.

supplement.evidence: Detailed bioassay data (individual replicates and exact counts) are located in the supplementary files: 'Table S1: Susceptibility test of Anopheles gambiae s.l. with permethrin; Table S2: Susceptibility test of Anopheles gambiae s.l. with deltamethrin.'

assessment.summary: This study assesses pyrethroid resistance profiles and underlying mechanisms in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations across five eco-epidemiological settings in Cameroon between 2019 and 2021. It reports WHO susceptibility bioassays, PBO synergist assays, and target-site resistance genotyping (Vgsc L995F, L995S, and N1570Y) in unexposed field-collected mosquitoes.
